full_text: REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg., EDSA Corner Mapagmaha/ St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 88 s. 2010 June 09, 2010 SB MEMBER ROMULO Z. SARMIENTO Municipality of Laua-an Antique Dear SB Member Sarmiento: This concerns your letter-query seeking the opinion of this Department regarding the exercise of profession of an elective barangay official and double compensation. With regard to the issue on the exercise of profession of an elective local official, please be informed that we already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 24, series of 2004, dated February 17, 2004. In said opinion, the Local Government Code provides that barangay elective officials are allowed by law to practice their professions and engage in any occupation provided that such practice or engagement will not constitute a violation of Sec. 7 of RA 6713. regards the issue on double compensation, please be informed that we had already answered a similar issue in DILG Opinion No. 18, s. 2004 dated February 9, 2004 where we opined that the prohibition on double compensation applies only to appointment to public office or position and not appointment to a private office. Photocopies of the aforesaid DILG Opinions are hereto attached for your ready reference. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Acting Secretary: . JESUS .
